name: Bulgaria

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 6437360 inhabitants, recorded as 6.437 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Collected on 2026-07-27, in Bulgarian, in the transversal venues pass, after the first attempt the same day had abandoned the country on access. The ministry register that would settle Bulgaria in one document was never reached — mc.government.bg answered 503 on three routes, curl failed on certificate verification, and the archived copies that exist on the Wayback Machine are refused to both tools available here. The route that worked instead was the slower one: the encyclopedia's categories for puppet and drama-puppet theatres, which give the candidate list, then each theatre's own statement of status. Bulgaria makes that unusually readable, because the status is carried in the name — Държавен куклен театър means state puppet theatre — and the entries say who pays. Seven units, six houses and one stage. Plovdiv states on its own site that it is a repertory theatre financed by the Ministry of Culture; Burgas that it holds state status since 1962; Vidin that it became a state puppet theatre in 1981 and is financed by the ministry; Stara Zagora that it is a repertory theatre on state financing, founded 1957; Gabrovo that it has been a state puppet theatre since 1971; Ruse that it is a state cultural institute specialising in puppet productions. The one stage is Pleven, where the Ivan Radoev drama-puppet theatre is a state establishment with mixed financing from the ministry and the municipality, and the puppet company sits inside it. Seven is a floor, and an unusually low one — this is the country in the record where the gap between what is counted and what exists is widest. Six further drama-puppet theatres are known by name and town and are not counted: Vratsa, Shumen, Kardzhali, Haskovo, Pazardzhik and Silistra, each an institution whose name declares a puppet company, none of which could be read for its status or for the survival of that company. Nor are the puppet houses of Sofia, Varna, Sliven, Yambol, Targovishte and Dobrich, which are named in the same sources. The Sofia case is the sharpest: the Stolichen kuklen teatar, founded 1946 by Mara Penkova with her own money, was the first puppet theatre in the country, and the word stolichen means of the capital — but a designation is not a statement of who funds it, and the theatre's own site answered 403. Under the rule of this repository that is thirteen candidates left out, and the honest reading of 7 is not a count of Bulgarian puppetry but a count of what one day's reachable pages could prove. Vidin carries no coordinate: the geocoder placed its street in Dimovo, a different municipality of the same province, and a wrong point is worse than none.

observations.reasoning: Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. One establishment retained: NATFIZ Krastyo Sarafov, Sofia. Criteria read at source: higher education, degree-granting with a bachelor's award and the named professional qualification Puppet Theatre Actor, puppetry explicit in the title, national academy under the state. The same institution also carries a puppet directing stream; counted by establishment, so 1 and not 2. Upper bound held at 1: the page read states the qualification can be obtained only at NATFIZ, an exhaustiveness claim that was read rather than inferred. Caveat: that claim covers only the performing stream.

establishments.description: Bulgaria's national theatre and film academy, founded 1948. It carries both acting and directing streams for puppet theatre, and its own pages state the actor qualification is obtainable nowhere else in the country.
